title: De-slop Engineering: Refactor codebase for cleanliness, reusability, and maintainability
description:
SCOPE: Review and refactor GigQuest codebase to remove unnecessary complexity and improve code quality

GOALS:
- Remove over-engineered solutions and unnecessary abstractions
- Consolidate duplicate logic across components
- Simplify complex functions into smaller, focused units
- Improve component reusability and composability
- Eliminate dead code and unused imports
- Standardize patterns across similar components

PRIORITY AREAS:
1. src/components/ - Review React components for duplicate logic and unnecessary complexity
2. src/lib/ - Simplify utility functions, remove unused code
3. src/store/ - Ensure state management patterns are consistent
4. src/data/ - Consolidate data transformation logic

SUCCESS CRITERIA:
- Code follows single responsibility principle
- No functions longer than 50 lines (except where truly necessary)
- Common patterns extracted into reusable utilities
- Test coverage maintained or improved
- No breaking changes to existing functionality
- Performance maintained or improved

DELIVERABLES:
- Refactored code following project style guidelines
- Documentation of major changes made
- List of removed dead code/unused features
